title: NovoFab Manual Band Saws, 10″ to 15-3/4″ — Value Line | NovoTech
meta_description: NovoFab Machinery manual gravity-feed band saws in Canada: NF-M 10 series (mitre vise, swivel bow, hydraulic down-feed, twin-mitre) and the Ø15-3/4″ NF-M 16. Value line with CSA panels, parts and support in Mississauga.
intro: NovoTech's own value line of gravity-feed pivot saws: the bow descends on a hydraulic damper with adjustable feed pressure, a belt or gear drive gives several blade speeds, and every model ships with a coolant pump and a stop rod. Four 10-inch models cover mitre-vise, swivel-bow, hydraulic-damped and twin-mitre cutting; the NF-M 16 handles 15-3/4″ rounds with a gear drive and carbide guides.
hero_points: Hydraulic-damped descent with adjustable feed pressure
Swivel and twin-mitre bows for angle cuts to 60°
Round capacities from Ø10″ (254 mm) to Ø15-3/4″ (400 mm)
hero_brand_line: NovoFab Machinery is NovoTech's own value line: proven designs built to our specification, with CSA-approved panels, a 1-year warranty and parts and support from Mississauga.

groups.lead: Ten- to sixteen-inch pivot saws with hydraulic descent control, belt or gear drive and mitre bows at a lower price — specified, stocked and supported by NovoTech.

faq_title: Questions we get asked about NovoFab Machinery manual band saws

faq.q: What is the difference between the NF-M 10, 10 S, 10 D and 10 T?
faq.a: All four are 10-inch gravity-feed saws with the same 2 HP motor. The NF-M 10 cuts angles with a mitre vise, the NF-M 10 S has a bow that swivels 45°–90°, the NF-M 10 D has a larger frame (18″ wide stock) with hydraulic down-feed control, and the NF-M 10 T swivels both ways — 45° left and right, 60° right.

faq.q: How does the value line differ from the Bekamak premium line?
faq.a: NovoFab saws are proven designs built to NovoTech's specification at a lower price; Bekamak saws are built in Turkey with European components and heavier construction. Both come with a CSA-approved electrical panel, a 1-year warranty and spare parts and technical support from Mississauga. Compare the Bekamak manual band saws.

faq.q: When should I move up to a hydraulic (semi-automatic) saw?
faq.a: When you cut more than a few dozen pieces a day, or when the operator is tied up holding the bow. The NF-H series clamps hydraulically, cuts at a preset feed and lifts the bow by itself — see the NovoFab semi-automatic band saws.

faq.q: What voltage do these saws run on?
faq.a: Three-phase machines are supplied for 600 V with a CSA-approved electrical panel; 208 V, 240 V or 480 V 3-phase are available on request.
